answer: Cloning a key into 12 hands breaks the sequence because two signers race the same nonce, which means a shared-credential farm convicts itself on the first collision. Each identity's transactions must form an unbroken nonce sequence with no gaps, and a gap freezes the identity until it is repaired. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
